import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductSplitting
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyZeroConnected
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyPoint
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Circle
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.PathConnected

/-!
# Integral cohomology ranks of finite products of circles

The actual circle-product cohomology splitting gives finite free cohomology
for every finite torus. Its ranks satisfy Pascal's recurrence, hence are the
binomial coefficients used in Mumford's integral cohomology calculation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Prod.instModule

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Split off the zero coordinate of a finite product of circles. -/
def finSuccCircleHomeomorph (d : ℕ) :
    (Fin (d + 1) → Circle) ≃ₜ (Fin d → Circle) × Circle where
  toFun f := (fun i => f i.succ, f 0)
  invFun p := Fin.cons p.2 p.1
  left_inv f := Fin.cons_self_tail f
  right_inv _ := rfl
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply i.succ).prodMk
    (continuous_apply 0)
  continuous_invFun := continuous_pi
    (Fin.cases continuous_snd fun i => (continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst)

/-- The circle-product decomposition after splitting the zero torus coordinate. -/
def torusCohomologySuccEquiv (d n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin (d + 1) → Circle)) (n + 1) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) (n + 1) ×
        IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n :=
  (singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv
    (X := TopCat.of (Fin (d + 1) → Circle))
    (Y := TopCat.of ((Fin d → Circle) × Circle))
    (finSuccCircleHomeomorph d).toHomotopyEquiv (n + 1)).symm.trans
      (circleProductCohomologyEquiv (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) 1 n)

/-- Integral cohomology of a finite torus is finite free of binomial rank. -/
theorem torusCohomology_free_finite_finrank (d n : ℕ) :
    Module.Free ℤ (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) ∧
      Module.Finite ℤ (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) ∧
        Module.finrank ℤ (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) =
          d.choose n := by
  induction d generalizing n with
  | zero =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          letI : PathConnectedSpace (Fin 0 → Circle) :=
            ⟨⟨fun _ => 1⟩, fun x y =>
              ⟨Path.pi (fun i => PathConnectedSpace.somePath (x i) (y i))⟩⟩
          let e := singularZeroCohomologyEquivInt (TopCat.of (Fin 0 → Circle)) (fun _ => 1)
          refine ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv e.symm, Module.Finite.equiv e.symm, ?_⟩
          simpa using e.finrank_eq
      | succ n =>
          letI := integralSingularCohomology_subsingleton
            (X := TopCat.of (Fin 0 → Circle)) n
          refine ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
          simp [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
  | succ d ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          letI : PathConnectedSpace (Fin (d + 1) → Circle) :=
            ⟨⟨fun _ => 1⟩, fun x y =>
              ⟨Path.pi (fun i => PathConnectedSpace.somePath (x i) (y i))⟩⟩
          let e := singularZeroCohomologyEquivInt (TopCat.of (Fin (d + 1) → Circle))
            (fun _ => 1)
          refine ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv e.symm, Module.Finite.equiv e.symm, ?_⟩
          simpa using e.finrank_eq
      | succ n =>
          obtain ⟨hfree₁, hfinite₁, hrank₁⟩ := ih (n + 1)
          obtain ⟨hfree₀, hfinite₀, hrank₀⟩ := ih n
          letI := hfree₁
          letI := hfinite₁
          letI := hfree₀
          letI := hfinite₀
          let e := torusCohomologySuccEquiv d n
          refine ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv e.symm, Module.Finite.equiv e.symm, ?_⟩
          rw [e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod, hrank₁, hrank₀, Nat.choose_succ_succ]
          exact Nat.add_comm _ _

instance torusCohomology_free (d n : ℕ) :
    Module.Free ℤ (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) :=
  (torusCohomology_free_finite_finrank d n).1

instance torusCohomology_finite (d n : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite ℤ (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) :=
  (torusCohomology_free_finite_finrank d n).2.1

/-- The rank in degree `n` of the `d`-dimensional torus is `d.choose n`. -/
theorem torusCohomology_finrank (d n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) =
      d.choose n :=
  (torusCohomology_free_finite_finrank d n).2.2

end Mumford.Analytic
